title: Weekly Send Limit Increases on the Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
### Conditions for a decision

On a Pocketwire Personal Account, a weekly send limit increase can be decided only while the account status is active, only on plans whose limit increase is available, and only on a limit increase request from the customer that is still submitted. Each condition is read from the system records of the account and of the customer's request.

**Account age.** The decision is made no earlier than the plan's minimum account age in calendar days after the account opened date. Account age is counted in calendar days from the opened date, the day after opening being day 1, and a decision on the day the minimum is reached qualifies.

**Spacing.** The decision is made no earlier than the plan's spacing in calendar days after the previous limit decision date; an account with no previous limit decision date passes this spacing. Spacing is counted in calendar days from the previous limit decision date, the day after it being day 1, and a decision on the day the spacing is reached qualifies.

| Hypothetical illustration | Account age (minimum 30 days) | Spacing (90 days) |
|---|---|---|
| Decision on the 30th / 90th calendar day after the anchor date | Met | Met |
| Decision on the 29th / 89th calendar day after the anchor date | Not met | Not met |

### Declines

A request is declined while any unauthorized-payment claim on the account is still pending or while the account is inside its post-recovery period. A request at or below the current effective limit is declined as needing no change.

### Approval

An approval sets the approved weekly send limit to the lower of the requested limit and the maximum new limit, where the maximum new limit is the lower of the plan's ceiling for an approved weekly limit and the current effective weekly limit raised by the plan's largest single increase percentage, rounded to the cent. The current effective weekly limit is the approved weekly send limit when one is recorded and otherwise the plan's weekly send limit.

| Hypothetical: current effective limit 7000.00, largest increase 50 percent, ceiling 15000.00 | Maximum new limit 10500.00 |
|---|---|
| Request 12000.00 | Approved at 10500.00 |
| Request 9000.00 | Approved at 9000.00 |
| Request 7000.00 | Declined as needing no change |

### Timing and record

A submitted request is decided within the plan's decision target in business days of its submission; the customer cannot have it decided sooner. Every decision, approval or decline, records the limit decision date as the decision date and closes the request as approved or declined; the per-payment limit and the cash-out limits are never changed by a limit increase. An approved limit stays with the account across later plan changes but is capped by the new plan's ceiling when that ceiling is lower.
